title: Sakeva Interlude
description: Optimized vanilla+ modpack with a few extra tweaks.
body:
**About modpack**\
This pack was designed exclusively for [Sakeva](https://discord.com/invite/sakeva) SMP. It stays true to the original Minecraft gameplay while boosting performance and optimization. There are a few small tweaks to make things easier, make your overall experience smoother & more enjoyable.

**Official Discord server**\
The modpack also includes an official [Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/sakeva).
